body:
meta : handle host views ( #30217 )

- meta : handle views of tensors allocated on the host

A view shares the memory of its view_src, so ggml-alloc never allocates a view in

the buffer of the split it lands in - the scheduler copies the source into the

split and the ops that use the view read that copy. The view node itself is a noop

and does not need a split of its own, but the meta backend asserted when one was

left inside a meta split:

- ggml_backend_meta_get_split_state() dereferenced tensor->buffer->context

- the graph rebuild mapped every node with ggml_backend_meta_buffer_simple_tensor()

Accept such nodes when they are views of host tensors, which also generalizes the

previous s_copy_main workaround. This fixes the assert hit by KV cache views when

using --split-mode tensor with partial offload.

summaryZh: llama.cpp 发布 b11528 版本，改进了 meta 后端对宿主机张量视图的处理逻辑。该修复解决了在开启 tensor split 模式且进行部分卸载（partial offload）时 KV cache 视图触发的 assert 崩溃问题，提升了跨设备拆分推理的稳定性。
